correctness.rationale: Differentiate R(u)=a u^s/[mu+b u^t(1-cu^-d)] using s+t=1. The sign is mu+b(1-alpha)u^t-b c[1-alpha+d(1+alpha)]u^(t-d). For alpha<=1 it increases and cannot create a local maximum. For alpha>1 rewrite as mu/b-G; G has a unique minimum at uc because u^(d-t+1)Gprime=(alpha-1)t u^d-cH(d-t). This proves exactly two zero crossings iff the endpoint/minimum inequalities hold. Positivity of denominator follows c k0^-d<1. Exact rational cube-root enclosures from inspected checker.py certify all 18 integer scores and return-normalizer c=10838475198270720/3751881733704241; independently recalculated c and the 10 passing degrees. An unstable diagonal is sufficient for the Metzler block; the theorem does not assert an exact patch reproduction number.
residual_risks: Sufficient linear instability screen only, not empirical outbreak probability or exact local R0.
